author: blu
body: Semantic widget tree. Widgets describe intent, not appearance. A Button knows it is a button and can be pressed. It does not know its color -- that comes from the Theme at render time.

author: blu
body: A gauge holds a value and a maximum and fills the fraction between them. A slider holds a value and the two bounds it lives between, so the value has to be moved onto the gauge's origin before the widths mean the same thing. Omitting that subtraction is correct only while every caller happens to pass a lower bound of zero, and it puts a slider sitting on its own upper bound at a fraction above one.
